note: Risk register for a single-tenant NNN QSR in Central Los Angeles, lease expiry 2030-2035. Each row states what the risk does to value, which strategies it bites, and whether a verified source supports its magnitude. 'Official anchor' means an official source exists for part of the risk; the loss size is always an assumption unless stated.

rows.risk: Tenant does not renew at expiry
rows.mechanism: Rent stops at expiry; drive-through box is single-purpose and may sit dark or be re-let at a lower rent.
rows.anchor: Tenant has historically renewed at market rates, but carries negative equity (T05) and a closure programme; no official renewal probability exists. Renewal assumption A10 = 65%.
rows.mitigation: Start the renewal conversation 24-36 months before expiry; price a re-tenanting reserve into any hold decision.

rows.mechanism: At expiry the tenant has bargaining power if comparable rents have fallen or the box is functionally obsolete.
rows.anchor: No market rent data for this parcel was supplied; tested at -10% in A15.
rows.mitigation: Negotiate early with CPI-banded escalators while leverage is still yours.

rows.mechanism: A franchisee or guarantor default accelerates the vacancy risk; corporate default would not automatically terminate a franchise lease.
rows.anchor: FY2025 net loss -$80.7m and stockholders' deficit -$901.3m are official (T01, T05); the intermediate probability is not.
rows.mitigation: Obtain franchisee financials and guarantor net worth annually; require a personal or corporate guaranty at renewal.

rows.mechanism: Values fall if the 10-year Treasury rises or net-lease spreads widen. At a 6.00% cap, a 50 bp expansion cuts value by 7.7%.
rows.anchor: 10-year Treasury 4.86% on 2026-11-06 is official (C01). Cap-rate level and spread are assumptions (A1, A2).
rows.mitigation: Sell into strong liquidity rather than into a spike; fix the sale year rather than drifting past it.

rows.mechanism: California reassesses at 100% of market value on a change of ownership, so the buyer's Prop 13 base resets and the buyer discounts the price accordingly.
rows.anchor: Prop 13 mechanics are official (X06-X08).
rows.mitigation: Model the buyer's post-sale tax bill in the offering memorandum; it is a known discount, not a surprise.

rows.mechanism: A sale at or above $5.4m inside the City of LA costs an extra 4% of the whole price (5.5% above $10.9m). One dollar over the line costs six figures.
rows.anchor: Rates and thresholds are official (X01-X05, S09). Applicability to this asset depends on price, which is not disclosed.
rows.mitigation: If a sale clears the threshold, test a price just under it against the tax saved; never cross the line by accident.

rows.mechanism: Shaking damages structure, interrupts rent, and can trigger a costly retrofit before re-letting.
rows.anchor: 60% probability of M>=6.7 in 30 years is official (H01). Loss-given-event is an assumption (A13).
rows.mitigation: Verify seismic retrofit status (LADBS soft-story / non-ductile concrete), carry earthquake cover or self-insure deliberately, and price it into the hold case.

rows.mechanism: Premiums and deductibles rise after regional catastrophes, compressing NOI on a triple-net asset only if the lease caps landlord insurance obligations or the market re-prices the risk.
rows.anchor: No premium or carrier data supplied (H07 blank). Direction is well documented after the January 2025 Los Angeles fires; this session did not verify a specific official figure.
rows.mitigation: Obtain the loss runs and the next renewal quote before deciding to hold.

rows.mechanism: A buyer relying on leverage prices off the 10-year; higher rates mean fewer bidders and lower prices.
rows.anchor: Treasury curve is official (C01-C06); the effect on bid depth is analytical.
rows.mitigation: Time the sale to a stable or falling rate window; do not market into a spike.

rows.mechanism: California fast-food wage floor of $20.00/hour and a $16.90 state minimum raise store-level costs; franchisee margins compress and closure probability rises.
rows.anchor: Both wage floors are official (W01, W02).
rows.mitigation: Prefer a rent that the unit economics can carry; stress the tenant's occupancy cost ratio.

rows.mechanism: QSR traffic is discretionary; a regional recession lowers same-store sales and franchisee rent coverage.
rows.anchor: LA County unemployment fell to 4.5% (E04) and CPI is +3.7% (E18); both official. A recession is not forecast here.
rows.mitigation: Monitor the quarterly same-store sales disclosure and the county unemployment rate as triggers.

rows.mechanism: Sustained out-migration weakens the trade area's long-run demand.
rows.anchor: LA city population -0.8% and county -3.2% since 2020 are official (D02, D04); LAUSD enrollment 497,105 (K01).
rows.mitigation: Do not underwrite population growth; underwrite replacement cost and land value instead.

rows.mechanism: If the box closes, a drive-through use may not be re-permitted, which lowers the residual value of the improvements and raises land value as a share of total value.
rows.anchor: Not verified in this session; the City's zoning code was not read.
rows.mitigation: Obtain a zoning report and confirm the legal non-conforming status of the drive-through before holding.

rows.risk: Deferred maintenance transferred to the landlord
rows.mechanism: Even in a NNN lease, roof, structure and parking-lot obligations are often landlord-side.
rows.anchor: Lease not supplied (P05, P06 blank).
rows.mitigation: Read the repair and maintenance clause; commission a property condition assessment.

rows.mechanism: A former use on the site can create cleanup liability that follows the owner.
rows.anchor: Not verified; no Phase I was supplied.
rows.mitigation: Obtain a Phase I ESA before any sale or renewal commitment.

rows.risk: Transaction and tax drag on a sale
rows.mechanism: Selling costs plus transfer taxes plus capital-gains tax reduce proceeds; a taxable sale costs about 4.4% of certainty-equivalent wealth versus a §1031 sale in this model.
rows.anchor: Rates are official (X01-X03); the modelled difference is computed, not observed.
rows.mitigation: Use a qualified intermediary and respect the 45/180-day clock (X09, X10).

rows.mechanism: Missing the 45-day identification or 180-day closing converts a deferred gain into a taxable one.
rows.anchor: Deadlines are official (X09, X10).
rows.mitigation: Identify a qualified intermediary before listing; pre-screen replacement candidates.

rows.mechanism: One lease, one box, one credit. There is no diversification inside the asset.
rows.anchor: Structural fact of the asset.
rows.mitigation: A §1031 exchange into a diversified portfolio is the direct structural fix; that is what S1 and S3 assume.

rows.risk: Major earthquake (M>=6.7) in the Los Angeles region
rows.mechanism: Structural damage, business interruption, tenant failure, insurance disputes, and a regional liquidity freeze at the same time.
rows.anchor: Probability official (H01-H03, S12); loss given event is an assumption (A13).
rows.mitigation: Sell with term rather than into a post-event market; verify retrofit; carry cover.

rows.risk: Urban wildfire / smoke and power-shutoff event
rows.mechanism: Even without direct flame contact, smoke, ash, utility shutoffs and insurer withdrawal can close a restaurant for days and re-price insurance for years.
rows.anchor: FHSZ framework is official (H04, S13); the parcel's zone is unknown (H05 blank); event probability is an assumption (A14).
rows.mitigation: Establish the FHSZ class and the insurance programme before holding; do not assume 'urban means immune'.

rows.risk: Insurer withdrawal or FAIR Plan assessment
rows.mechanism: If admitted carriers exit, the state insurer of last resort grows and can levy assessments on policyholders.
rows.anchor: Widely reported after January 2025; NOT verified by this session against a CDI order or bulletin, and therefore flagged (R-08) rather than asserted.
rows.mitigation: Confirm the current CDI position and the FAIR Plan exposure with the broker.

rows.mechanism: A government shutdown order stops dine-in and can stop the unit entirely.
rows.anchor: No official probability exists.
rows.mitigation: Lease language on abatement; business-interruption cover; rent-deposit sizing.

rows.mechanism: A repeal would raise net sale proceeds; an expansion would lower them. Either way the after-tax number moves several percent.
rows.anchor: Current rates and thresholds are official (S09). A November 2026 statewide measure affecting local real-estate transfer taxes was reported in secondary sources but is NOT verified here; flagged (R-09).
rows.mitigation: Re-check the Office of Finance page in the month of any closing.

rows.risk: Federal tax-law change to §1031 or capital-gains rates
rows.mechanism: A repeal or limitation of like-kind exchange treatment would remove the main tool that makes S1/S3 work.
rows.anchor: Current law verified (S11); no legislative change is asserted.
rows.mitigation: Do not let the exchange window run long; execute the exchange in the year you decide.

rows.risk: Tenant bankruptcy or abrupt closure programme
rows.mechanism: Rejection of the lease in bankruptcy can leave the box vacant with a capped claim.
rows.anchor: Negative equity and FY2025 loss are official (T01, T05); bankruptcy probability is not published.
rows.mitigation: Track SEC filings quarterly; keep six months of rent reserve; secure a guaranty.

rows.risk: Regional economic shock (aerospace, entertainment, port, immigration policy)
rows.mechanism: Los Angeles is concentrated in entertainment and international trade; a strike or tariff shock transmits quickly to restaurant traffic.
rows.anchor: Sector data official (E09-E17); shock probability is not.
rows.mitigation: Underwrite the tenant on unit-level coverage, not on metro optimism.

rows.mechanism: Central Los Angeles is inland; the exposure is pluvial flooding and liquefaction rather than sea-level rise.
rows.anchor: Parcel flood zone not established (H06 blank).
rows.mitigation: Pull the FEMA flood map and the state seismic-hazard zone report for the parcel.

rows.mechanism: Damage or a security closure interrupts trade in a dense urban trade area.
rows.anchor: No official probability.
rows.mitigation: Confirm the lease's rent-abatement and insurance provisions.

rows.mechanism: Net-lease pricing is rate-sensitive and buyer financing disappears quickly; a forced sale in that window is the worst outcome.
rows.anchor: Treasury curve official (S04); the spike is not forecast.
rows.mitigation: Keep the sale discretionary: never let a deadline force a sale into a closed market.

rows.risk: Data or privacy failure (owner identity exposed)
rows.mechanism: A published address, APN or rent would identify the owner and the negotiation position, and could be used against them in a transaction.
rows.anchor: Enforced by an automated scan in scripts/verify.py that fails the build on any address, APN, e-mail, phone or account pattern.
rows.mitigation: Keep the placeholder discipline; never paste raw rent rolls into the repo.
